headline.title: Relay Runs the Night Shift
headline.dek: Every agent reported in before sunrise
headline.body:
The nightly relay finished on time: each agent filed a manifest, **The Gardiner** stitched them together, and Ganja put the paper to bed.

Nothing needs your hands this morning except the job listing on the classifieds page.

police_blotter.text: Suspect intake file found loitering in the backlog. Sorted and released.

job_listings.title: Approve a backup
job_listings.details: Take a fresh backup of the camera config.
job_listings.ask: Approve to let CYPH3R run it.

want_ads.title: WANTED: a new SD card
want_ads.ask: Buy one and swap it in.

funnies.joke: Why did the agent get a raise? It finally stopped reading the whole vault.

predictions: Backlog should clear by Friday at this pace.
on_this_day: The first Double Wide went to press.
tending: Bring in the basil before the first frost.
almanac_notes.saying: A tidy vault makes a short night.
